summary: Practise strategic analysis, portfolio choices and executive scorecards. Explore the five-day course outline and assess its fit for your role.
lede: Strategic leadership helps senior managers turn enterprise priorities into governed choices, resource decisions and measurable follow-through. For functional heads, executive team members and senior programme leads, the course develops skills to assess strategic position, compare scenarios and prioritize initiatives. Participants also map decision rights and build a Balanced Scorecard with measures and an executive review narrative, connecting strategic choices to management reviews and follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior professionals who shape organizational direction, allocate resources or translate executive priorities into decisions across functions. It suits managers who need a structured way to test strategic options and show how decisions connect to performance measures.
prerequisites: Prior responsibility for a team, function or cross-functional decisions is expected. No coding or specialist software is required.
